--- title: "Cálculo do NDVI e classificação não-supervisionada de imagens" format: html execute: freeze: true # never re-render during project render number-sections: true --- ## Introdução ## Bibliotecas e dados utlizados nesta lição ## Preparação dos dados ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pasta_dados <- '../lab_08/dados/' dados_raster <- terra::rast(paste0(pasta_dados, '/sr_rad_correct.tif')) dados_raster ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` class : SpatRaster size : 1460, 688, 4 (nrow, ncol, nlyr) resolution : 8, 8 (x, y) extent : 333358, 338862, 7381094, 7392774 (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) coord. ref. : WGS 84 / UTM zone 23S (EPSG:32723) source : sr_rad_correct.tif names : CBERS_4~4_BAND3, CBERS_4~4_BAND2, CBERS_4~4_BAND1, CBERS_4~4_BAND4 min values : 0, 0, 0, 0 max values : 967, 947, 907, 963 ``` ::: ::: ## Aritmética raster e manipulação de dados pixel a pixel. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} selecao <- dados_raster[[1]] > 100 & dados_raster[[2]] > 100 & dados_raster[[3]] > 100# & # dados_raster[[4]] < 50 imagem_sem_nuvens <- dados_raster imagem_sem_nuvens[selecao] <- NA ``` ::: ## Visualização ### Visualiza as bandas separadamente ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} terra::plot(imagem_sem_nuvens) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](cap_08_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Visualiza uma composição colorida. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} terra::plotRGB(imagem_sem_nuvens, stretch='hist') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](cap_08_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ### Calculando o NDVI ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ndvi <- (dados_raster[[4]] - dados_raster[[1]])/(dados_raster[[1]] + dados_raster[[4]]) names(ndvi) <- 'ndvi' terra::add(dados_raster) <- ndvi ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} terra::writeRaster(dados_raster, '../dados/sr_rad_correct_ndvi.tif', datatype='FLT4S', overwrite=TRUE) ``` ::: Visualiza a banda ndvi. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} paleta <- terra::map.pal("grey", 255) terra::plot(ndvi, type='continuous', col=paleta) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](cap_08_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} mapview::mapview(terra::resample(ndvi, y=c(1.5, 1.5)), col.regions=paleta, na.color='transparent', alpha=1) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Executando o algoritmo do k-means no R Obs: Calcula a distancia para cada centroide e atribui como cluster a menor. ### Kmeans no terra ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} total_clusters <- 5 dados_raster_normalizados <- terra::scale(dados_raster, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE) terra::global(dados_raster_normalizados, "mean", na.rm=TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` mean CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND3 -3.514842e-14 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND2 5.532972e-15 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND1 4.915553e-15 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND4 -2.604386e-15 ndvi 6.567906e-14 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} terra::global(dados_raster_normalizados, "sd", na.rm=TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` sd CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND3 1 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND2 1 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND1 1 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND4 1 ndvi 1 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} resultado_kmeans <- terra::k_means(dados_raster_normalizados, centers=total_clusters, maxcell=10^5) terra::barplot(resultado_kmeans) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: [barplot] a sample of 99.6% of the raster cells were used to estimate frequencies ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](cap_08_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cores_clusters <- lapply(1:total_clusters, function (n_cluster) { dados_raster_lin <- terra::stretch(dados_raster, minq=0.02, maxq=0.98) dados_cluster <- dados_raster_lin[resultado_kmeans==n_cluster] dados_cluster <- dados_cluster[, 1:3] cluster_cor_media <- colMeans(dados_cluster) cluster_cor_media[1] <- round(cluster_cor_media[1]) cluster_cor_media[2] <- round(cluster_cor_media[2]) cluster_cor_media[3] <- round(cluster_cor_media[3]) print(max(dados_cluster/255)) cluster_cor_media_hsv = rgb2hsv (cluster_cor_media[1], cluster_cor_media[2], cluster_cor_media[3]) cluster_cor_media_hsv[2] = 1 cluster_cor_media_hsv[3] = 0.6 string_cor_media = hsv(h=cluster_cor_media_hsv[1], s=cluster_cor_media_hsv[2], v=cluster_cor_media_hsv[3]) return(string_cor_media) }) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.748538 [1] 1 [1] 0.7719298 [1] 1 [1] 1 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cores_clusters <- unlist(cores_clusters)# Para cores aleatórias use: terra::map.pal('ramp', 5). terra::plot(resultado_kmeans, type='classes', col=cores_clusters) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](cap_08_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-2.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} #terra::plot(resultado_kmeans_manual_final, type='classes', col=cores_clusters) kmeans_mapview <- terra::resample(resultado_kmeans, y=c(1.5, 1.5), method='near') kmeans_mapview <- terra::as.factor(kmeans_mapview) kmeans_mapview ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` class : SpatRaster size : 974, 459, 1 (nrow, ncol, nlyr) resolution : 12, 12 (x, y) extent : 333358, 338866, 7381094, 7392782 (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) coord. ref. : WGS 84 / UTM zone 23S (EPSG:32723) source(s) : memory categories : lyr1 name : lyr1 min value : 1 max value : 5 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} terra::levels(kmeans_mapview) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [[1]] ID lyr1 1 1 1 2 2 2 3 3 3 4 4 4 5 5 5 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} mapview::mapview(kmeans_mapview, col.regions=cores_clusters, na.color='transparent', method='ngb', alpha=1) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Found more colors (6) than zcol values (5)! Trimming colors to match number of zcol values. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ### Alternativa para execução do k-means manualmente ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} amostra_kmeans <- terra::spatSample(dados_raster, size=10^5, na.rm=TRUE) resultado_kmeans_manual <- stats::kmeans(amostra_kmeans, centers = 5) resultado_kmeans_manual$centers ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND3 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND2 1 25.89292 24.71938 2 106.06778 69.50122 3 175.01921 117.14004 4 41.63573 28.11865 5 349.42491 273.64205 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND1 CBERS_4A_WPM_20240529_202_143_L4_BAND4 1 16.20980 204.54660 2 61.73799 122.00543 3 101.37175 182.24672 4 27.78233 66.26866 5 252.54255 324.12203 ndvi 1 0.78901191 2 0.06769200 3 0.01875319 4 0.18532875 5 -0.03780392 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} atribui_cluster <- function(pixel) { if(is.na(pixel[1]) == TRUE) return(NA) matriz_distancias <- as.matrix(stats::dist(rbind(resultado_kmeans_manual$centers, pixel))) num_cluster <- which.min(matriz_distancias[nrow(matriz_distancias),1:(ncol(matriz_distancias)-1)]) #print(num_cluster) return(as.numeric(num_cluster)) } resultado_kmeans_manual_final <- terra::app(dados_raster, fun=atribui_cluster) kmeans_mapview_manual <- terra::resample(resultado_kmeans_manual_final, y=c(1.5, 1.5), method='near') kmeans_mapview_manual <- terra::as.factor(kmeans_mapview_manual) mapview::mapview(kmeans_mapview, col.regions=cores_clusters, na.color='transparent', method='ngb', alpha=1, layer.name='Kmeans - Terra') + mapview::mapview(kmeans_mapview_manual, col.regions=cores_clusters, na.color='transparent', method='ngb', alpha=1, layer.name='Kmeans - Manual') ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: Found more colors (6) than zcol values (5)! Trimming colors to match number of zcol values. Warning: Found more colors (6) than zcol values (5)! Trimming colors to match number of zcol values. ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
